description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class `ClaimAttachmentAPI` within the `OrangeHRM"Claim"` namespace. It handles CRUD operations for claim attachments in a Human Resource Management system, including listing, creating, viewing, updating, and deleting claim attachments. The class integrates with the OrangeHRM framework, utilizes annotations for OpenAPI documentation, and enforces authorization and validation rules.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class for managing claim attachments, providing endpoints for listing, creating, viewing, updating, and deleting attachments related to HR claims in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim attachments for a specific request ID, supports sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new claim attachment for a specific request, including handling file upload and metadata.

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Private helper to populate a ClaimAttachment entity from request parameters.

methods.name: getPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Constructs a PartialClaimAttachment model from a ClaimAttachment entity for API responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified claim attachments associated with a request.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific claim attachment.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates metadata and/or file of an existing claim attachment.
